root_cause: The root cause of the bug is the comparison logic within the inner nested for-loop that calculates `goodKeys`. The original condition `if (currentPerm[l] == test[j][l])` incorrectly matches 0s in `currentPerm` and `test` arrays, leading to an inaccurate count of `goodKeys`. The correct logic should only count matches when both `currentPerm[l]` and `test[j][l]` are 1, thereby ensuring only valid keys are counted towards `goodKeys`.
